green.note: Green is market status, not positive EV.

requirements: Independently verified agreement from multiple distinct users in same thread
Explicit backing as value betting selection

Primary grassroots link, named author, pre-race timestamp and explicit selection.

Syndicated press naps and editorial previews, separate from grassroots evidence.
